_meta.description: Curated tool/command -> ATT&CK technique aliases for the deterministic keyword-tagging pre-pass (app/mitre/keyword_tag.py). Small and high-confidence by design: an alias belongs here only when a detection rule mentioning it is near-unambiguously about the mapped technique. Precision beats coverage - anything uncertain is left for the AI tagger.
_meta.matching: Patterns are matched literally (case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed) against rule name/description/logic with non-alphanumeric boundaries on both sides; the left boundary also rejects '.', so 'at.exe' never fires inside 'look at exe files' and '-enc' never fires inside 'base64-encoded'.
sources: MITRE ATT&CK v19 technique pages (procedure examples): attack.mitre.org
LOLBAS project (living-off-the-land binary -> technique mappings): lolbas-project.github.io
Red Canary Threat Detection Report (tool/technique prevalence): redcanary.com/threat-detection-report
_meta.notes: Deviation from the Phase 6 seed list: bare 'net user' is ambiguous between account creation (T1136.001) and account discovery (T1087.001), so only the unambiguous 'net user /add' form is mapped. Every technique_id is re-validated through attack_data.resolve() at match time (revoked IDs remap, dead IDs drop).
